what: Integration test seeds disallowed header only in round-2/review-round-summary.md but production failures cite ## Round 2 from rejected-findings aggregate bleed
scenario_or_breakage: Live runs copy review-round-summary.md to impl root so _build_tally_body uses one round summary with allowed # Review Round N headers; pre-fix failures come from impl/rejected-findings.md built by write_rejected_findings_aggregate plus _render_rejected_findings_for_tally bleeding ## Round 2 after the first ### FINDING_* line. A summary-only poison may not reproduce the committed-log failure mode when round summaries alone validate.
suggested_fix: Require round-2 setup to seed multi-round rejected-findings.md (or call write_rejected_findings_aggregate on round-*/rejected-findings-full.md fixtures) with a round-1 finding then a ## Round 2 section header in the rendered body path; keep the summary poison as secondary coverage only.

what: Plan fixes write-tally rc 4 but leaves flush_review_batches success/failure invisible to Step 5 loop
scenario_or_breakage: flush_review_batches return value is ignored in _run_round; round 2+ tally write failures only emit _err warnings. If a future regression reintroduces a fatal write-tally path, multi-round tallies can freeze at round 1 again with no test failure beyond the new integration test.
suggested_fix: No change required for this bug; optionally note in test_review_and_fix.py that the new test is the sole guard for per-round tally rewrite until a later issue wires flush return into Step 5 telemetry.
